summary: Iteration 45: frontend-only check of PR #12 'Scripture Academy' in the web preview (390x844 and 360x640, light mode and dark mode via prefers-color-scheme). Node suite: 39/39 pass. tsc --noEmit is clean. No pageerrors and no red screens in 12 browser runs. WORKING: (1) Expanded stations tora-1-1, parables-1, parables-6, john-3, gb1-8, gb1-9 and rev-seals were each played from start to finish. The old claims come first. The 3 new Lehrtext sections follow ('Text und Aufbau', 'Hintergrund und Einordnung', 'Biblische Zusammenhänge'). All old task types still work: multi, gap, tf, order, mc, free and match. All new mc, match and free tasks pass. Every exam passed with a full score: 6/6, 7/7 or 7/7. (2) The new stations ac-gen-cain, ac-par-workers, ac-acts-ship, ac-hist-saul, ac-pred-joy and ac-song-mutual open, load their readings and show existing art (adam-eva, verkuendigung, paulus, saul, salomo). Each has 5 tasks and 5 exam items, all answerable, passed 5/5 and gave +60 EP. (3) Locking works. On history-1 every ac-hist-* node is marked 'gesperrt'. The station sheets show 'Schließe zuerst ab: <vorherige Station>' for ac-gen-isaac and ac-acts-ship. (4) Progress is kept. After completing tora-1-1 and parables-1, XP was 100. After a reload XP was still 100, both stations showed as completed, and tora-1-2 and parables-2 were unlocked. (5) The links from term cards work. tora-1-1#2 שַׁבָּת opens /living/words?entry=word-0-39, parables-1#1 λόγος opens word-1-1 and ac-gen-cain#0 חָטָא opens word-0-22. Going back returns to the station at Phase 2/7. No link is shown when nothing matches (gb1-8, john-3, parables-6, rev-seals), which matches the data (134 terms have a link). (6) Verse ranges that used to be to:200 now stop at the real chapter end: tora-2-1 '2. Mose 1,1–22', letters-1 'Römer 1,18–32' and letters-13 '1. Johannes 1,5–10'. Their texts load without error. (7) The maps show no node overlap on tora-1 (9 stations), acts (12) or history-1 (14). There are no duplicate Debora or Gideon stations; only gb1-8 and gb1-9 exist. ISSUES (all minor): (a) Hebrew-first term titles get dir=auto and computed direction rtl. In term cards and in match items they show right-aligned, as '(bara) בָּרָא', with the transliteration left of the word and the Hebrew touching the rotate icon. (b) Match tasks with only 2 pairs use shuffle() and not shuffleDifferent(), so about half the time the right column lines up with the left. The 'word' exam items have only 2 options when a row has 2 terms. (c) New ac-* stations come after the campaign's final 'Prüfung' station in john, matthew, prophets, letters, psalms-1, psalms-2 and history-1. history-1 is titled 'Josua & Richter' but now holds Saul, Athalja and Manasse. (d) map-fit-all cannot show all stations in tall campaigns because of the cover-fit minimum scale. On tora-1 after fit-all, the top node ac-gen-isaac sits under the Legende/Stationen chips. Panning still reaches it. (e) Some topics are covered twice: ac-hos-love and prophets-7, ac-letters-james and letters-11, ac-pred-joy and psalms-5-meaning, ac-song-mutual and psalms-6-poetry, ac-letters-rom3/rom8 and letters-1. These are deeper studies, not copies. In john-3, 'Zeichen (griech. sēmeion)' and 'σημεῖον (sēmeion)' are two cards for the same word.

ui_bugs.component: Term card / match item with Hebrew
ui_bugs.issue: Term strings start with a Hebrew character, so RN-web gives them dir=auto and computed direction rtl. The whole line shows right-aligned as '(shofet) שֹׁפֵט', with the transliteration before the word and no gap to the rotate icon. Affects app/station/[id].tsx:213 (termTitle) and src/components/TaskView.tsx:233 (matchText).

issues: After map-fit-all, the top station ac-gen-isaac lands at y≈107, above the map area and under the Legende/Stationen chips. The cover-fit minimum scale (ZoomableMap.tsx:77) keeps tall campaigns from fitting (parables is now mapH 5480). Panning still reaches every node.
Match tasks with 2 pairs use shuffle() (TaskView.tsx:59), so the order often matches the left column. 'word' exam items (academy-core.ts:51) have only 2 options when a row has 2 terms.
ac-* stations come after the final exam station in john, matthew, prophets, letters, psalms-1, psalms-2 and history-1. The exam is no longer the end of the campaign.
history-1 'Josua & Richter' now includes Saul (1Sam), Athalja (2Kön) and Manasse/Josia, which do not fit the title.

action_items: Term card front (station/[id].tsx:213) and match items (TaskView.tsx:233): render the original word and the transliteration as separate Text elements. Put writingDirection 'rtl' only on the Hebrew part, as living/[id].tsx does, or set writingDirection 'ltr' on the container. Add a gap between the text and the rotate icon.
Optional: use shuffleDifferent for the match right column. Give 'word' exam items with 2 terms an extra distractor.

Optional: place new ac-* stations before the campaign's exam station, or say in the UI that they are bonus units after the exam. Consider renaming history-1 or moving ac-hist-saul/athan/manasse to a Samuel/Kings campaign.
Optional: let map-fit-all zoom below the cover minimum in adventure mode, or keep the top node clear of the overlay chips.
Optional: merge the duplicate term cards in john-3 ('Zeichen (griech. sēmeion)' and 'σημεῖον (sēmeion)').
critical_code_review_comments: academy-core.ts:51 – exam items repeat the task mc questions word for word, with the options in a different order. The doc says this is intended.
station/[id].tsx:204-205 – wordEntry(t.term) is computed twice on every render for each flipped card. It is cheap, but could be memoised.
The station screen does not block locked stations opened by deep link. This was already the case before this PR.
Known and not new: the gb1-* image keys have no bundled images, so those stations show no illustration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested flows work; 1 minor RTL display bug and some minor design notes

seed_data_creation: None in the DB. Progress came from playing stations in isolated browser contexts (localStorage only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Close the intro with intro-skip-button, then welcome-start. To play a station: exec /app/tests/academy_runner_snippet.py in browser_automation and call run_station(page, id). First run tests/academy_answers_gen.mjs to create /tmp/answers_t.json and /tmp/answers_e.json. Separate keys are needed because academy mc options are rotated differently in tasks and in the exam. GAP_BLANKS is hardcoded for john-3. Match testIDs task-right-<i> use the ORIGINAL pair index, so clicking left-i then right-i is always correct. Each browser_automation call uses a fresh localStorage. Lock state can be read from the aria-label of station-node-<id> ('…, gesperrt'). Dark mode: page.emulate_media(color_scheme='dark'); the settings chip theme-dark did not survive page.goto in the test.
